say:3:1321415001:1.text: Why are you here again? Don't tell me want more hangover brew.
say:3:1321415001:1.source_cn: 你们怎么又来了？解酒的东西可不能多喝！

say:4:1321415002:1.text: No, no, no! We're here to find someone. Did a young man pass by here earlier?
say:4:1321415002:1.source_cn: 不不不，我们是来找人的！刚才有没有一个年轻男人经过这里？

say:5:1321415003:1.text: Yes, he looks a little like the kid next to us. He may also smell of booze.
say:5:1321415003:1.source_cn: 外貌特点的话……嗯，他长得和我们身边这个小朋友有点像，...

say:6:1321415004:1.text: Yeah, someone like that did pass by.
say:6:1321415004:1.source_cn: 噢，刚才的确有那么个年轻人经过。

say:7:1321415005:1.text: He was mumbling about something... I think he was saying that he wasn't a coward or some such. Anyway, he didn't seem completely there if you know what I'm saying.
say:7:1321415005:1.source_cn: 他过去的时候，还嘟嘟囔囔地说着什么，好像是在说自己不是...

say:10:1321415006:1.text: Do you know where he went?
say:10:1321415006:1.source_cn: 那、那您知道他去哪了吗？

say:11:1321415007:1.text: Hey, kid, the mine is only this big. Other than that exit there, where else can he go?
say:11:1321415007:1.source_cn: 嘿，小伙子，矿洞就这么大，除了另一个出口，他还能去哪？

say:12:1321415008:1.text: That exit?! That leads to the <style="highlight">ancient battlefield</style>. There are still undead there!

say:16:1321415010:1.text: Magister, we have to hurry! Stephan may encounter the undead!
say:16:1321415010:1.source_cn: 主人，我们得赶快追上他！万一碰到活死人就不好了！
say:16:1321415010:1.male: Magister, we have to hurry! Stephan may encounter the undead!
say:16:1321415010:1.female: Magister, we have to hurry! Stephan may encounter the undead!

say:20:1321415012:1.text: The ancient battlefield is really dangerous. Why don't you go back to town? Your brother will be very worried if he sees you there.
say:20:1321415012:1.source_cn: 古战场很危险，你还是不要去了吧？要不然你哥哥看到你也会...

say:21:1321415013:1.text: No, I have to find my brother! You can't stop me! I'll go alone if I have to!
say:21:1321415013:1.source_cn: 不行，我必须要去找哥哥！你们劝我也没用！

say:22:1321415014:1.text: Alright... Then you have to follow behind us and not wander off!
say:22:1321415014:1.source_cn: 唉，好吧……那你得一直跟着我们，不许乱跑！
